description: This file implements a search and replace extension for a rich text editor using Tiptap and ProseMirror, including search logic, decorations, commands, and plugin integration.

classes.name: SearchReplace
classes.description: A Tiptap extension providing search and replace functionality with decorations, commands, and plugin state management.

methods.name: updateView
methods.description: Dispatches the current transaction to update the editor view.

methods.name: regex
methods.description: Creates a RegExp object based on search settings, handling regex enablement and case/whole word options.

methods.name: searchDocument
methods.description: Performs a search over the document, returning decorations and results matching the search term.

methods.name: resultsToDecorations
methods.description: Converts search results into ProseMirror decorations for highlighting.

methods.name: scrollIntoView
methods.description: Scrolls the DOM node into view with smooth behavior.
